scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,client --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: concurrently --group --names root,shared,server,client "tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit" "tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit" "tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit" "tsc -p client/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p client/tsconfig.node.json --noEmit"
